Reactorcore Art (RC Art)
==
PACK: Plasma Electric Animations

--

Pixel-art sprites pack depicting different plasma/electricity/vortex/gravity-force related animation frames or objects.

The package offers both sheets and individual images. Both are PNGs with transparent background.

--

As a hint, the solid orbs can be combined with particle systems that spew animated sprite particles to create interesting looking projectiles with trails or cool impact/blast/disturbance effects.

--

For default in image import settings, all sprites/textures have been set to 32 pixels per unit and using a point filter so they appear crisp.

--

Contact:
mailto:reactorcoregames@gmail.com

Enjoy!
